QUEST-BOARD.Title: Quest Board
QUEST-BOARD.ResetImagesConfirm: Clear all custom images? The images from the selected theme will be used instead.
QUEST-BOARD.DeleteBoardConfirm: Delete the board “{name}” and all of its quests?
QUEST-BOARD.DeleteQuestConfirm:
Delete the quest “{name}”?

This action cannot be undone.
QUEST-BOARD.OpenSceneFirst: Open the scene where you want to place the board first.
QUEST-BOARD.BoardPlaced: Board “{name}” has been placed on the current scene.
QUEST-BOARD.JournalPickerError: Could not open the journal page picker. See the browser console for details.
QUEST-BOARD.ManagerDescription: Boards, templates, and archive for this world.
QUEST-BOARD.CreateFirstBoard: Create your first board to start posting quests.
QUEST-BOARD.TransformFlyer: Move along the arc to rotate; move toward or away from the center to resize
QUEST-BOARD.NoQuests: There are no quests on this board yet.
QUEST-BOARD.AddFirstQuest: Select “Add Quest” to pin the first quest.
QUEST-BOARD.BoardFooter: Select a quest to read it.
QUEST-BOARD.ArrangeInstructions: Drag a quest by its top handle; use the corner handle to rotate it by moving along the arc, or resize it by moving toward or away from the center.
QUEST-BOARD.ArrangeHint: Select “Arrange Quests” to change the position of the quests.
QUEST-BOARD.UseDefaultBoardImage: Use the board image from Appearance Settings
QUEST-BOARD.ChooseImageFoundry: Choose an image in the Foundry File Browser
QUEST-BOARD.DefaultBoardImageHint: If left blank, the default board image from the Quest Board settings will be used.
QUEST-BOARD.QuestSummary: Short text shown on the small scroll
QUEST-BOARD.QuestDescriptionPlaceholder: Write the quest from your character’s perspective. Include the conditions and what is offered in return.
QUEST-BOARD.UseDefaultPaperImage: Use the image from Appearance Settings
QUEST-BOARD.QuestImageHint: An uploaded image becomes a standalone quest, displayed both on the board and when opened. You can also use it to create a custom background for your quest. Leave this field blank to create a standard text-only quest.
QUEST-BOARD.DefaultSealHint: If left blank, the default seal for the selected theme will be used.
QUEST-BOARD.ThemeHint: The selected theme sets the default appearance of the board and its quests.
QUEST-BOARD.OverrideImagesHint: Enable this option to replace individual elements. If a path is left blank, the image from the selected theme will be used.
QUEST-BOARD.SettingsMenuHint: Choose a theme and custom images for quest boards.
QUEST-BOARD.AppearanceSettingHint: The default theme for quest boards in this game world.
QUEST-BOARD.JournalChooseHint: Select a page. Its UUID will be added to the quest.
QUEST-BOARD.NoJournalPages: There are no journal pages yet.
QUEST-BOARD.CreateJournalPageHint: Create a page in the Journal directory and try again.
QUEST-BOARD.CategoryUncategorizedDescription: Quests that have not been assigned a category by the GM.
QUEST-BOARD.CategoryMainDescription: Key quests that affect the development of the main story and the world.
QUEST-BOARD.CategoryOrdersDescription: Delivering cargo, escorting caravans, and gathering items and materials.
QUEST-BOARD.CategoryBountyDescription: Tracking down criminals and missing people, as well as hunting wild creatures.
QUEST-BOARD.CategoryExplorationDescription: Expeditions, exploring unknown territories, searching for relics, and investigating mysterious phenomena.
QUEST-BOARD.CategoryOtherDescription: Quests that do not fit into the other categories.
QUEST-BOARD.HideFastenersHint: Hides decorative fasteners from quest flyers, including nails, bolts, and clips.
QUEST-BOARD.HideCategoryIconsHint: Hides category icons on board flyers and when viewing an opened quest.
QUEST-BOARD.ShowBoardToPlayersHint: When disabled, the board is hidden from the players' board list, but can still be opened through its token on the scene.
QUEST-BOARD.BoardNotAvailable: This board is not published and cannot be opened from the board list.
QUEST-BOARD.TemplatesHint: Templates are shared across this world and are not tied to a board.
QUEST-BOARD.TemplatesEmpty: No templates yet. Save a quest as a template from the editor.
QUEST-BOARD.ExpiryDaysHint: Leave empty or enter 0 for no expiration. The duration uses the Foundry calendar from publication time.
QUEST-BOARD.ArchiveHint: Completed and expired quests are stored here.
QUEST-BOARD.ChooseBoardForTemplate: Choose the board for the quest created from template “{template}”.
